The '''Corellian Defense Force''' (or '''CDF'''), also known as the '''Corellian Armed Forces''' or simply as the '''Corellian Military''', was the [[Planetary Security Forces|defense force]] that protected the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].

==Organization==
The Corellian Defense Force was one of the two organizations, along with the [[Corellian Security Force]], tasked with the defense of the Corellian sector. The CDF was a military force while CorSec was rather [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The Corellian Defense Force was based in the [[Corellian Defense Force Headquarters|CDF Headquarters]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="Betrayal" /> the sector capital.<ref name="SoF" />

The Corellian Defense Force had many branches as well as divisions, the main two being the [[Corellian Defense Forces Space Service|Space Service]] and the CDF groundside.<ref name="AaC" /> The CDF also included the [[Corellian Home Fleet]], that defended the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]],<ref name="Tempest" /> the [[Corellian militia]],<ref name="militia-CDF" /> [[Corellian Customs]],<ref name="SWG:HT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Hidden Turbolaser}} on Corellia</ref> and [[Corellian Traffic Control]].<ref name="AaC" />

The CDF was formally led by the ruler of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], initially the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]],<ref name="SoF" /> and later the [[Five World Prime Minister]]. Depending on the organization of the Corellian governments, supervision of the Defense Force was commonly delegated to a [[Minister of War (Five Worlds)|Minister of War]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> or to a [[Minister of Defense (Five Worlds)|Minister of Defense]].<ref name="Tempest" /> Within the CDF, the highest ranking officer was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] that held the title of [[Supreme Commander of the Corellian Defense Force]].<ref name="Exile" /> Along with various [[staff officer]]s, all those political leaders and high-ranking officers formed the [[Corellian High Command]].<ref name="Tempest" />

One of the duty of the CDF, along with CorSec, was to guard the valuable [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CEC shipyards|shipyards]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
In the three centuries that followed the dissolution of the [[Corellian empire]], the Corellian Defense Force was led by the [[Diktat]] of Corellia who also held the title of Governor-General of the Corellian sector.<ref name="SoF" /> During that period, the defense force built large warships to defend the sector against exterior threats. Like all big [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] employed in the rich [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] sectors of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they were fitted with a limited-range [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] so as not to be involved in aggressive military actions.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], when the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] underwent discussion in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Diktat [[Shyla Merricope]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] [[Contemplanys Hermi|withdrew]] the Corellian sector from active participation in the Senate and enforced an isolationist policy towards the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It forbid the usage of Corellian military and security forces in any centralized Republic military, therefore preventing the deployment of the Corellian Defense Force during the upcoming [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref>

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Corellian sector became an [[Imperial client state]] loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Although the Corellian Diktat kept the title of Governor-General of the Corellian sector, his administration of the sector, including the control of the Corellian Defense Force, was overseen by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Corellian sector.<ref name="SoF" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Diktat was bound to provide elements of the Corellian Defense Force to support Imperial armed forces against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As the war intensified, Corellian military forces were repeatedly sent away to assist the Empire, leaving the Corellian sector poorly defended. Hence, [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] exploded in the sector.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> In turn, the Corellian Defense Force increasingly subcontracted civilians, such as independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], to carry out various missions, including military assignments.<ref name="SWG:HT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] allied with local [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] deployed a surface-to-orbit [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] on Corellia. The soldiers used the weapon to fire at CDF [[Corellian Customs|customs]] vessels during smuggling runs. The Corellian Defense Force eventually localized the the turbolaser, disguised as an unobtrusive power station, and dispatched a civilian strike team to eliminate the criminals and destroy the weapon. The CDF preferred to use spacers rather than regular troops to reduce the chances for the enemies to discover that their position has been compromised.<ref name="SWG:HT" /> The same year, a bunch of smugglers stole a crate of [[ion beamer]]s from the CDF [[Mobile Medical Unit 4-077]] during a training exercise in the Corellian wilderness. Again, spacers were recruited by the Corellian Defense Force to deal with the criminals.<ref name="SWG:MHHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Mobile Hospital Has Smuggler Problem}} on Corellia</ref>

After the death of the Emperor at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], many Imperial loyalists fled the collapsing Empire to take refuge in the Imperial-friendly Corellian sector.<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> They extensively joined the Space Service of the Corellian Defense Force.<ref name="AaC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Diktat dissolved the prestigious Corellian Security Force and created the [[Public Safety Service]],<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> an Imperialistic security force and political police tasked with protecting the Diktat's autocratic regime.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> Contrary to the CorSec that was fairly independent,<ref name="HG">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref> the PSS was part of the CDF.<ref name="AaC" /> 

Sometime as early as [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref> the Diktat's regime collapsed.<ref name="AaC" /> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] later gained control of the Corellian sector and appointed a Governor-General named [[Micamberlecto]] to rule the planet Corellia and the sector.<ref name="CTD" /> The Governor-General became the new commander-in-chief of the Corellian Defense Force but the Corellian troops, in particular Imperial and Diktat loyalists, were reluctant to obey to a New Republic appointee.<ref name="AaC" /> 

During the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], most of the ground-based units of the Corellian Defense Force remained loyal to the Governor-General whereas the CDF Space Service massively betrayed the New Republic.<ref name="AaC" /> At the beginning of the Corellian Insurrection, the majority of the Corellian space forces defected with their vessels, including [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], to the [[Sacorrian Triad]].<ref name="SaC">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref> Later, during the takeover of Corellia by [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]'s [[Human League]], many CDF troops died trying to protect Governor-General Micamberlecto. Meanwhile, the few remaining CDF space forces in the Corellian system had joined Thrackan Sal-Solo.<ref name="AaC" /> The New Republic eventually defeated the Sacorrian Triad that was responsible for the conflict at the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Corellian Crisis)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]]. There, the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic navy]] annihilated the Sacorrian fleet, including the treacherous CDF elements.<ref name="SaC" />

Near the end of the Galactic Civil War, vessels of the Corellian Defense Force served in the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]] under [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Bel Iblis]].<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

About a decade later, after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] abolished the position of Governor-General to permit the Corellians to implement their own political regime. Command of the Corellian Defense Force was given to the Prime Minister of the [[Five Worlds]], the elected executive of the Corellian system. However, tensions soon arose between the Corellians and the galactic government. Prior to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a secret fleet of [[Corellian Dreadnaught]] was constructed in the Kiris Asteroid Cluster without the approval of the Galactic Alliance in order to augment the existing Defense Forces. When the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] finally erupted between the Galactic Alliance and the Five Worlds, the Corellian Defense Force was thrown into the battle.<ref name="Betrayal" /> In the first stage of the war, the CDF, and more particularly the [[Corellian Home Fleet]], was highly summoned since the [[Blockade of Corellia|blockaded]] Corellia was the hotspot of the conflict.<ref name="Betrayal" /><ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref><ref name="Exile" /> This period of extreme tensions was responsible for severe [[Triumvirate (Corellian)|political instability]] on Corellia, leading to high turnover among the Corellian Supreme Commanders.<ref name="Exile" /> Admiral [[Vara Karathas]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> was replaced by Admiral [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]],<ref name="Tempest" /> later replaced by Admiral [[Genna Delpin]].<ref name="Exile" /> Some time later, the war escalated and other worlds joined Corellia in the conflict, forming the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Exile" /> Military command of the CDF was transferred from the Corellian Supreme Commander to the newly appointed [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military]].<ref name="TCSWE-Delpin">{{CSWECite|I|181|Delpin, Genna}}</ref> Thereafter, Corellian Defense Force elements were deployed throughout the galaxy alongside other Confederation forces to fight against the Galactic Alliance. The CDF fought at the [[Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Hapes]],<ref name="Tempest" /> at the [[Battle of Gilatter VIII]],<ref name="Exile" /> at the [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kuat]], at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref> and at the [[Second Battle of Roche]]. Eventually, the Second Galactic Civil War ended with the death of [[Darth Caedus]] in [[41 ABY]] during the [[Battle of Uroro Station]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Members of the Corellian Defense Force wore different kinds of outfits such as the [[Type III "Berethron" Personal Modular Armor/Legends|Type III "Berethron" Personal Modular Armor]], the [[TX-3 combat flight suit/Legends|TX-3 combat flight suit]], or the [[Nomad greatcoat]]<ref name="SoF" /> [[Corona Footwear Company]] was responsible for providing boots to the CDF.<ref name="AaC" />

One prestigious Corellian award, the [[Corellian Bloodstripe]]s, was rewarded by the Corellian government to its most heroic citizens,<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> usually to members of the Corellian Military.<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

===Vehicles===
{{Quote|They have nothing in the size class of Dodonna, but they have Strident-class Star Defenders and a large number of frigates, corvettes, patrol boats, gunships, and heavy transports. Mostly Corellian Engineering Corporation, of course.|A [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] [[Sensor officer/Legends|sensor officer]]|<ref name="Betrayal" />}}
The CDF used various types of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], mostly manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation.<ref name="Betrayal" /> The capital ships included [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> (such as the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]<ref name="TCSWE-Silaban">{{CSWECite|III|151|''Silaban''}}</ref> and the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvette]]<ref name="SoF" />), [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> (including assault frigates<ref name="Inferno" />), [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]],<ref name="Bloodlines" /> [[Star Defender]]s (such as the [[Strident-class Star Defender|''Strident''-class Star Defender]]),<ref name="Betrayal" /> [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]],<ref name="Inferno" /> and [[Corellian Dreadnaught|dreadnaughts]].<ref name="Tempest" /> Smaller vessels encompassed [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol boats]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> (such as the [[Pocket Patrol Boat]]<ref name="SoF" />) and [[Transport/Legends|transports]]<ref name="Betrayal" /> (such as the [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carrier]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>). [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] models included the [[Light Attack Fighter Model 250]], the [[Heavy/Light Attack Fighter 500]],<ref name="CTD" /> the [[CL-1c Lancet interceptor]],<ref name="SoF" /> the [[X-TIE Fighter]],<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> the [[Starfighter/Legends|Corellian attack fighter]] and the [[YT-5100 Shriek-class bomber|YT-5100 ''Shriek''-class bomber]].<ref name="Betrayal" />

In addition, the CDF used ancient models of Imperial starships decades after the end of the Galactic Civil War such as [[TIE series/Legends|TIE series fighters]], [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]]s, [[A-10 interceptor]]s, [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s, [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]],<ref name="Betrayal" /> [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] and [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Fury" />
